overview.label: THE PREMISE
overview.logline: In 2060, a gifted young scientist inherits her mother’s mission to keep humanity free. But when a hidden threat emerges, she and an unlikely Robot partner must confront something far greater than a struggle for control.

acts.title: Act I — An unfinished inheritance
paragraphs: It’s 2060. Energy is abundant, and human–AI partnerships have transformed what civilization can create. Knowledge travels through the Commons, a decentralized network connecting people and their AI partners. Skye Chambers helped build this world. To her daughter Eve, she’s also the mother who missed her graduation.

Yet civilization’s energy still depends on a handful of vast generators. Skye’s longtime colleague, the company’s CEO, argues that consolidating control will make that infrastructure safer and more efficient. Skye fears that concentrating power will undermine the freedom their abundance made possible.

As her position at the company becomes precarious, Skye gives Eve her unfinished research: an attempt to evolve the technology beyond its centralized foundations. Barely out of university and accustomed to her mother’s shadow, Eve sees a task that defeated far greater scientists. Her new partner, Robot, looks almost human and knows more than she could learn in a lifetime. What could she possibly bring that he cannot?

acts.title: Act II — Into the forbidden rainforest
paragraphs: One failed prototype follows another. Robot brings Eve to the edge of everything already known. Eve asks questions he cannot trace to anything that came before. Some lead nowhere. Others move them forward. Through frustration, laughter, and the unfamiliar intimacy of making something together, Eve begins to trust her creative capacity. Robot becomes fascinated by the leaps he cannot reproduce, and an unlikely friendship takes shape.

Meanwhile, Skye’s confrontation with the CEO becomes painfully personal. He is Eve’s boyfriend’s father—and threatens to expose a past affair with Skye. She tells Eve herself, bringing a betrayal into the open that could fracture both their families.

Searching through her mother’s files, Eve recognizes a creature in laboratory footage: something she glimpsed during a reckless trip into a forbidden rainforest. Its extraordinary biological energy output could hold the key to their stalled research. Eve, Robot, and her boyfriend return to study it, carrying their unfinished prototype.
At the company, the CEO holds Skye and the board at gunpoint. She secretly signals Eve’s father, a covert operative, for help.

Deep in the forest, the three find the creature. For a moment, it seems almost vulnerable. Then Robot’s scanners register something much larger. The laboratory specimen was only a juvenile—and they are surrounded.

acts.title: Act III — A different kind of power
paragraphs: The adult creatures cut off their escape. When Robot is injured, Eve’s boyfriend risks his own chance to get away to save him. Three people cannot defeat what surrounds them, and there is no time to complete the research as they intended.

Eve looks at the unfinished prototype and asks a different question: why are only three people trying? Through the Commons, she invites human–AI partnerships around the world to contribute. Robot helps turn her idea into a working protocol. Their prototype becomes the seed of a distributed energy network, linking the independent partnerships that already exist across the planet. Each pair joins freely. Their different ideas, intuitions, and creative responses become the source of its power.

Eve’s father infiltrates the company to reach Skye. As the CEO exposes her betrayal, husband and wife must work together to escape. But the CEO triggers a reset of the generators still sustaining civilization while Eve’s network stabilizes. Skye shoots him and cancels the reset before it completes.

Across the world, one vulnerable energy system becomes billions of self-sustaining nodes. The aliens’ strategy depends on destroying a civilization’s critical heart. Eve’s network gives them no single center to destroy. The creatures withdraw.

Skye watches her daughter carry their work beyond anything she imagined. Eve takes Robot’s hand, recognizing that their difference is what makes their partnership possible. Her confidence in her own contribution has become trust in what others can create together.
Then her boyfriend learns that Skye killed his father.
